messages:
Priya (PM): quick heads-up — Acme asked for a per-tenant SLA lane (p99 99.9) + reserved burst for a handful of private tenants. they want GA in ~6 weeks. can we scope infra/runtime/security impacts? @Jun @Sam @Nadia
Jun (Eng Runtime): short answer: required runtime work = routing policy + per-tenant KV cache namespaces + prewarm hooks and a per-tenant quant profile option. POC ~2 devs x 3w, +1w stabilization. need input on autoscale/capacity from infra.
Sam (Infra): infra work = reservation API for capacity slots, autoscale override for reserved lanes, and network mapping for private deploys (VPC routes). also runbook + alert recipes. estimate 2 infra engs x 2-3w for core + testing.
Nadia (Security): security asks: formal tenant isolation threat model, KMS/HSM enforceable key separation, audit log rollout, and checklist for private-onprem vs VPC. can review in parallel but HSM/FIPS customers are blocking.
Olly (Product Ops): propose launch criteria: p99 latency <= 300ms on short prompts, cost uplift per request <30% (or explicit charge), cache hitrate telemetry enabled, and rollback criteria defined. will own customer comms + runbook templates.
Mateo (EngM): ops note: we should do a canary (10% traffic) with automatic fallback to shared lane on errors or tail latency regression. runtime should expose per-tenant throttles and a routing weight config.
Jun (Eng Runtime): snippet of suggested routing config:
```
route: per_tenant_sla:
  tenant_tag: "acme-priority"
  fallback: shared-default
  weight: 1.0
  prewarm: true
  cache_namespace: "tenant_acme"
```
Jun (Eng Runtime): also need to expose telemetry: per-tenant tail latency, cache hits, and token costs so product can decide pricing.
Sam (Infra): one more infra constraint — reserved capacity MUST be trialable across regions. that affects provisioning scripts. also we need a predictable rollout window for private deployments.
Nadia (Security): question: will tenant keys be customer-managed (KMS) or Redwood-managed? if customer-managed, onboarding adds 2 weeks for KMS integration and verification.
Priya (PM): good q — Acme prefers customer-managed keys. can we parallelize the KMS work with runtime POC?
Nadia (Security): yes, parallel is fine but gating for GA: completed KMS proof-of-concept and audit logging enabled.
Olly (Product Ops): i'll draft the rollout plan: alpha (internal + 1 customer) -> canary (10%) -> staged ramp. will include SLAs, pricing delta, and comms templates.
Mateo (EngM): proposal for owners + dates: Jun -> runtime POC by 3/22, Sam -> capacity plan + infra PRs by 3/22, Nadia -> threat model + KMS checklist by 3/24, Olly -> rollout playbook and pricing proposal by 3/24. sync Wed 10am weekly.
Priya (PM): sounds good. any big objections?
Jun (Eng Runtime): +1, might need a small infra support during POC.
Sam (Infra): ok. please tag infra on PRs and add pre-prod load test plan.
Nadia (Security): +1. will allocate 1 security engineer for KMS pathing.
Olly (Product Ops): :+1: will send draft comms by EOD Mon.
deploy-bot: created epic PER-TENANT-SLA-4343 and linked tasks for runtime/infra/security/product-ops
Priya (PM): action items recap:
- Jun: runtime POC, config + telemetry (due 1719000000)
- Sam: capacity reservation design + infra changes + runbook (due 1719000000)
- Nadia: threat model + KMS onboarding checklist (due 1719180000)
- Olly: rollout plan + pricing + comms (due 1719180000)
we'll reconvene Wed 10am. thanks everyone. :rocket:
Mateo (EngM): noted, adding perf test slot for Wed afternoon.
Priya (PM): closing — moving to weekly thread.
